newsitem.title: GERMANY: Varta AG ups stake in Brazil's Microlite.
newsitem.headline: Varta AG ups stake in Brazil's Microlite.

text.p: Varta Batterie AG, a unit of the German battery maker Varta AG, said on Monday that it had upped its stake in Brazil's Microlite AG, the leading battery maker in that country, to 50 percent.
In a compulsory statement, Varta said the increased stake gave it control of the management, while the remaining 50 percent was held by Brazilian investors.
Microlite will now concentrate on batteries for appliances, where it has sales of 130 million marks and a leading market position with a 50 percent market share, Varta said.
The group's car battery business will now become part of a joint venture with the U.S. company Johnson Controls Battery Group Inc.
Johnson Controls will take 67 percent of the shares, giving it management control. Varta Batterie holds the option of raising its 33 percent to 50 percent later on.
